points.description: States that a static array is initialized only once (e.g., at first call/program start) and is not re-initialized on each function call. Equivalent wording accepted.
Contrasts with a non-static (automatic/local) array, which is created and re-initialized every time the function is called (and does not keep its previous contents between calls).
